issues.on_page: Local license fees and fines 50,770 (General 6,990 + Other Governmental Funds 43,780)
issues.issue: The 43,780 Other Governmental Funds part is QCPU money. The QCPU schedule (p16) and the nonmajor combining schedule (p8) show no license or fine line, so this is probably state tax credit/aid that p3 mislabels. p3's QCPU column ties to the printed 376,674 (330,597+731+464+120+982+43,780). The p8/p16 lines (330,597+120+6,695+464+982 = 338,858) are 37,816 short of that total (37,816 = 43,780 + 731 - 6,695). No line was missed or misread and the gap is not a transfer: it is the report's own error, correctly recorded in report_discrepancies. The category follows the p3 label as printed, which is defensible, but it is doubtful.

issues.on_page: Other local receipts 3,460; p9 General Fund breakdown: 1921 Police court fines 710 + 1990 Other local receipts 2,750
issues.issue: The report prints this line's breakdown, so 710 could be split out as fines and forfeitures. Only 2,750 is genuinely unexplained.
This is a broad group with no review flag. The detail on p9-10 and p17 includes 3133 Nameplate capacity tax 7,470 (other taxes per the rules). Should carry review 'broad group; detail on p9-10'.
The label mixes fines and license fees and has no review note naming the mix. The same applies to detail[7] (1911 Local license fees and fines) and detail[10] (2110).

issues.on_page: Student support services 723,383 (General 272,654 + Other Governmental Funds 450,729)
issues.issue: 450,729 is Activities Fund spending (p8, p21), which the detail records as student activities. The label as printed supports support services, but the categories differ between receipts and detail.
The parenthetical is the extractor's annotation, not printed text. The amount -175,000 and budget -140,000 are correct, and the transfer ties to Nutrition +100,000 (p19) and Activities +75,000 (p21).
